The '''Continuing Medical Education''' was a training course that [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Nurse/Legends|nurses]] are required to go through upon orders from the [[Surgical Nursing Services]].<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Tolk le Trene]] was ordered by the [[Unidentified Surgical Nursing Services director|director]] of the Surgical Nursing Services to undergo a six hour course about decubitus care.<ref name="MedStar II" />
